Image Description: A blurry, white number 0 on a black background.

This image features a single, distorted numeral 0 in white, centered against a solid black backdrop. The numeral is rendered in a bold, sans-serif font and appears to be slightly pixelated or blurry, giving it a rough, low-resolution quality. The black background is completely flat and featureless, providing a stark contrast to the white numeral.
